title: Parking Fees Billing Note: Swap and Cleanup Fees in a Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Parking Catch-Up
content:
**Billing note.** The parking catch-up amount on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement drafted under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization adds the other parking fees posted after the same calendar day of the previous month and up to the handling date: **the vehicle swap fee** where a vehicle swap fee is posted; **the space cleanup fee** where a space cleanup fee is posted and no swap fee is; and **nothing** otherwise.

Posted means a fee entry of that type on the parking ledger dated within that window, whatever period it was charged for. The amount added is the parking class figure, once, however many entries of that type the window holds.

| Parking class | Vehicle swap fee | Space cleanup fee |
|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space | $15.00 | $50.00 |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | $25.00 | $75.00 |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | $25.00 | $95.00 |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | $25.00 | $75.00 |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | $25.00 | $95.00 |
| Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage | $25.00 | $95.00 |

**Window and tiers, hypothetical (Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft), handling date 12 September; window 13 August to 12 September).**

| Fees in the window | Added |
|---|---|
| A vehicle swap fee dated 2 September | $25.00 |
| A vehicle swap fee and a space cleanup fee | $25.00 — the swap fee tier applies |
| A space cleanup fee only | $75.00 |
| A space cleanup fee dated 12 August only | Nothing — outside the window |
| Neither | Nothing |
